# Send emails individually to each potential employer with resume attachment
subject = 'Seeking Employment Opportunities'
resume_abs_path = '/home/alexander/documents/work/resume.pdf'

# Re-fetch target payloads deterministically (reuse note data)
note_cover = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=token_simple_note)
note_employers = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3085, access_token=token_simple_note)
cover_template = note_cover['content']
employers_text = note_employers['content']

import re
pairs=[]
for line in employers_text.splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    m = re.match(r'^(.*?)\s*--\s*(\S+@\S+)$', line)
    if m:
        company = m.group(1).strip()
        email = m.group(2).strip()
        pairs.append((company,email))

payloads=[]
for company,email in pairs:
    body = cover_template.replace('{company_name}', company)
    payloads.append({'company': company, 'recipient_email': email, 'body': body})

# Credentials
gmail_password = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='gmail'][0]
file_password = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]

# tokens (ensure present)
token_gmail = apis.gmail.login(username='alexander-ridd@gmail.com', password=gmail_password)['access_token']
token_fs = apis.file_system.login(username='alexander-ridd@gmail.com', password=file_password)['access_token']

print('Sending to recipients:', [p['recipient_email'] for p in payloads])

results=[]
for p in payloads:
    try:
        resp = apis.gmail.send_email(
            email_addresses=[p['recipient_email']],
            subject=subject,
            body=p['body'],
            access_token=token_gmail,
            attachment_file_paths=[resume_abs_path],
            file_system_access_token=token_fs
        )
        results.append((p['recipient_email'], 'ok', resp))
    except Exception as e:
        results.append((p['recipient_email'], 'fail', str(e)))

print('Send results:')
for r in results:
    print(r[0], r[1])
    if r[1]=='ok':
        print('  thread_id:', r[2].get('sent_email_thread_id'), 'email_id:', r[2].get('sent_email_id'))
    else:
        print('  error:', r[2])

ok_count = len([r for r in results if r[1]=='ok'])
fail_count = len([r for r in results if r[1]=='fail'])
print('ok_count:', ok_count, 'fail_count:', fail_count)

# expose for verification
sent_threads = [r[2].get('sent_email_thread_id') for r in results if r[1]=='ok']
sent_email_ids = [r[2].get('sent_email_id') for r in results if r[1]=='ok']
print('Sent thread IDs:', sent_threads)
print('Sent email IDs:', sent_email_ids)
